and for all `s : Set X`, `s` is open iff it is the preimage of an open set.
name: Topology.IsEmbedding
typeText: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [tX : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X] → [tY : TopologicalSpace.{u_2} Y] → (X → Y) → Prop

source.code:
/-- A function between topological spaces is an embedding if it is injective,
  and for all `s : Set X`, `s` is open iff it is the preimage of an open set. -/
@[fun_prop, mk_iff]
structure IsEmbedding (f : X → Y) : Prop extends IsInducing f where
  /-- A topological embedding is injective. -/
  injective : Function.Injective f
